lesson.heading: The replication fork
lesson.intro: Build a clear mental model of how DNA copies itself before cell division.
lesson.schemeIntro: Match the colours in the diagram to the players in replication.
lesson.schemeNote: Arrows show the direction of synthesis: the leading strand grows continuously toward the fork, Okazaki fragments grow away from it in short pieces.
